units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 1) membership of municipalities in associations of municipalities;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 2) establishment of intermunicipal business companies and an intermunicipal print media outlet and online publication;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 3) establishment of nonprofit organizations by municipalities;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 4) conclusion of contracts and agreements;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 5) organization of interaction among councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 75. Forms of intermunicipal cooperation
units.text: 2. Associations of municipalities, intermunicipal business companies and nonprofit organizations established by municipalities may not be vested with the powers of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 75

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.label: Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 1. Associations of municipalities shall be established to organize interaction among local self-government bodies and to express and protect the common interests of residents of municipalities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 2. The organization and activities of associations of municipalities shall comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on nonprofit organizations applicable to associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 3. A council of municipalities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be formed in each constituent entity of the Russian Federation to ensure interaction among local self-government bodies, their officials and municipalities, and representation and protection of their common interests within the territory of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 4. State authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall interact with councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 5. Persons representing the governing bodies of councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including persons holding municipal offices, have the right to serve on coordinating, advisory and other bodies attached to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation whose activities concern matters falling within the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, and individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Associations of municipalities
units.text: 6. The council of municipalities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall prepare and submit to the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” an annual report on the state and development of local self-government in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Specific features of preparation of that report may be established by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.label: Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: 1. The Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall organize interaction among municipalities, councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, other associations of municipalities and nonprofit organizations whose objectives include ensuring the realization of citizens’ constitutional rights to exercise local self-government, for the purpose of representing and protecting the common interests of local self-government bodies and their officials, including representing those interests within the unified system of public authority and when organizing cooperation between municipalities and international organizations and foreign legal entities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: 2. The organization and activities of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on nonprofit organizations applicable to associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: 3. Councils of municipalities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be members of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: 4. Persons representing the governing bodies of the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”, including persons holding municipal offices, have the right to serve on coordinating, advisory and other bodies attached to federal executive authorities whose activities concern matters falling within the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, and individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government
units.text: 5. The Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government” shall prepare and submit to the Government of the Russian Federation an annual report on the state and development of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.label: Art. 78

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: 1. Intermunicipal business companies shall be established to pool the financial, material and other resources of municipalities for jointly addressing matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 78

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: 2. Intermunicipal business companies shall be established in the form of non-public joint-stock companies and limited liability companies by decision of the representative bodies of municipalities.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 78

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: 3. Intermunicipal business companies shall conduct their activities in accordance with the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 78

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: 4. State registration of intermunicipal business companies shall be carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 129-ФЗ of 08.08.2001 “On State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs”.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 78

units.locator: Article 78. Intermunicipal business companies
units.text: 5. Local self-government bodies may act as co-founders of an intermunicipal print media outlet and online publication.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 78

units.locator: Article 79. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities
units.text: Article 79. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities
units.label: Art. 79

units.locator: Article 79. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities
units.text: 1. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities shall be established in the form of autonomous nonprofit organizations and foundations by decision of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 79

units.locator: Article 79. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities
units.text: 2. Nonprofit organizations of municipalities shall conduct their activities in accordance with the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, Federal Law No. 7-ФЗ of 12.01.1996 “On Nonprofit Organizations” and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 79

units.locator: Chapter 9. International and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Chapter 9. International and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Chapter 9. International and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: The powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies include:
units.label: Art. 80 · “The powers of the federal executive authority authorized to…”

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 1) developing, implementing and ensuring the pursuit of a unified state policy in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 2) determining priority areas of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 3) representing the interests of the Russian Federation in relations with foreign states and international organizations on matters of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 4) providing constituent entities of the Russian Federation with legal, organizational and methodological support on matters of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 5) compiling and maintaining the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies with local self-government bodies of foreign states;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 80. Powers of the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 6) other powers in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 80

units.locator: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 81

units.locator: Article 81. Powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: The powers of state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies include legal regulation of the conduct of international and foreign economic relations by local self-government bodies, provision to local self-government bodies of legal, organizational and methodological support in conducting international and foreign economic relations, and other powers established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Art. 81 · text

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.label: Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies shall conduct international and foreign economic relations to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, with the agreement of the state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 2. The powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 1) holding meetings, consultations and other events in the field of international and foreign economic relations with representatives of state-territorial, administrative-territorial and municipal entities of foreign states;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 2) concluding agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies with local self-government bodies of foreign states;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 3) participating in the activities of international organizations in the field of intermunicipal cooperation within the powers of bodies established specifically for that purpose;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 4) participating in the development and implementation of projects under international programmes of intermunicipal cooperation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 82. Powers of local self-government bodies in the field of international and foreign economic relations
units.text: 5) other powers in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 82

units.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 83

units.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. To address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, local self-government bodies shall conclude agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations with local self-government bodies of foreign states, with the agreement of the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in whose territory the corresponding municipality is located, in accordance with the procedure determined by the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 83

units.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Registration by state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure determined by a law of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation and is a mandatory condition for such agreements to enter into force.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 83

units.locator: Article 83. Agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. Signed agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies shall be officially published in accordance with the procedure provided for official publication of municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 83

units.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 84

units.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Each year before 15.01, the head of the municipality shall inform the authorized state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with the procedure established by that authority, about the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality and the results of such relations in the preceding year.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 84

units.locator: Article 84. Reporting on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Each year before 01.02, the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall inform the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies, in accordance with the procedure established by that federal authority, about the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies and the results of such relations in the preceding year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 84

units.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 85

units.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. A municipality shall compile a list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality in accordance with the procedure determined by the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That list shall include all agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including agreements that have ceased to be in force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 85

units.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Each year before 15.01, the head of the municipality shall send the authorized state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including in it agreements concluded and agreements that ceased to be in force in the preceding year. If such a list is sent for the first time, it shall include all agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of the local self-government bodies of that municipality, including agreements that have ceased to be in force.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 85

units.locator: Article 85. List of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. On the basis of the lists provided for by this Article, the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall compile the list of agreements on the conduct of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation and, each year before 01.02, send that list to the federal executive authority authorized to perform functions of developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of international and foreign economic relations of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 85

units.locator: Chapter 10. Specific features of the organization of local self-government
units.text: Chapter 10. Specific features of the organization of local self-government
units.label: Chapter 10. Specific features of the organization of local self-government

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.label: Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: This Federal Law and other federal laws may establish specific features of the organization of local self-government:
units.label: Art. 86 · “This Federal Law and other federal laws may establish specific…”

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 1) in federal territories;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 2) in the territories of cities of federal significance;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 3) in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 86
